author: China Insights
description:
On a pitch-black, freezing river surface, two retirees nearly seventy years old allegedly carried out a perfect murder — disposing of the body, sinking the boat, and erasing all evidence — in just 29 minutes. A plot straight out of a crime thriller, yet this is the official account of a murder case in Linyi, Shandong Province. More than eight years have passed since the incident. After two first-instance trials and two appeals, these two white-haired elderly defendants are now awaiting a third first-instance verdict. Let me tell you what really happened behind this jaw-dropping story.
